column1: # Regions: the building blocks every border is made of. Each grows from its seed point over
# the cell mesh (see cgvideo/mesh.py) and stops more readily at rivers and custom lines.
# A region should be the smallest piece that ever changes hands on its own. To split one
# add a row with a new seed; to move a frontier precisely
# weight > 1 lets a region grow further before its neighbours claim the ground.
# modern_state is the state of the Union (or the neighbour) holding it in 2026: a reading aid.
